name: print-social-two-product-flyers-on-linen-with-wheat-stalks
title: Two A5 tech-product flyers, blue and burgundy, styled on pale linen with dried grass
whatItIs: Two flyers lie on a beige surface with dried wheat stalks and sun shadows: a white and blue 'All your tech needs' sheet with a cluster of gadgets, and a burgundy and white 'Sound that moves you' sheet with a red headphone render, icon list and price.
whatItMeans: Clean and commercial; natural props soften electronics marketing.
techniques: Show two flyers in different colourways together.
Style with dried grass and sun shadows.
Use a big product render on a curved white cut-out shape.
Keep contact info in a coloured footer bar.

vocabulary.definition: Two versions of a layout in different colours.
A rounded white shape carved into a coloured panel.
Organic props used in a mockup.
